name: Humboldt Herbals
tagline: Bulk herbs, teas, and botanical supplies in Eureka’s Old Town.
description: Humboldt Herbals has served Eureka since 1998. Its Old Town shop stocks bulk herbs and teas, culinary spices, tinctures, aromatherapy products, and botanical body care. Containers, glassware, and other herbalist supplies make it a useful stop for home blending and preparation projects.

photoCandidates.alt: Humboldt Herbals hanging sign outside the shop at 300 2nd Street

name: Bridget’s Botanicals
hours: Wednesday–Thursday: 11am–4pm; Friday: 11am–5pm; Saturday: 10am–5pm. Sunday openings vary; check with the shop.
tagline: Small-batch botanicals and hands-on herbal experiences in historic Littleton.
description: Bridget’s Botanicals combines a downtown Littleton apothecary with botanical education and private events. Founded by a scientist and certified herbalist, the business makes small-batch products with sustainably sourced ingredients. Its workshops include tea blending, aromatherapy mists, and botanical crafts, with a focus on women’s wellness.

photoCandidates.alt: Bridget’s Botanicals herbal products display at a botanical garden event

name: Orion’s Apothecary
tagline: An herbal shop and learning space for curious plant and mushroom enthusiasts.
description: Established in 2019, Orion’s Apothecary offers herbal blends, teas, mushroom products, and locally made botanical goods in Loveland. Its calendar includes tincture-making, tea classes for children, mushroom-growing workshops, and community meetups. Visit the shop to browse ingredients and seasonal products or check the website for upcoming classes.

Colorado Sunshine Tea from Orion’s Apothecary

name: Sacred Vibes Apothecary
tagline: A Brooklyn apothecary rooted in spiritual herbalism and community learning.
description: Founded by herbalist Karen Rose, Sacred Vibes Apothecary brings herbal teas, tinctures, and botanical preparations together in Brooklyn. The shop is also home to an educational community centered on spiritual herbalism. Its Art and Practice of Spiritual Herbalism apprenticeship offers a structured path for deeper study.

name: Moonrise Herbs
hours: Monday–Saturday: 10:30am–5:30pm; Sunday: noon–5pm. Confirm closing time before visiting; the website lists conflicting weekday hours.
tagline: An Arcata Plaza herb shop sharing botanical ingredients and plant knowledge since 1985.
description: Moonrise Herbs carries bulk herbs, teas, tinctures, essential oils, body care, books, and gifts on the Arcata Plaza. Founded by sisters Sarah and Lisa Hoyt in 1985, the business also hosts classes and offers herbal consultations by appointment. Its shelves include supplies for making your own herbal preparations.

name: Thyme Herbal Apothecary
tagline: Bulk herbs, house-blended teas, and botanical goods on Shrewsbury Street.
description: Thyme Herbal Apothecary stocks more than 200 organic and sustainably wildcrafted herbs, teas, and spices in Worcester. The shop makes its own herbal tisanes, tinctures, syrups, balms, and oils, alongside a selection of bath products, beeswax candles, and local honey. It has served the neighborhood since 2022.

name: Wild Heart Herb House
tagline: A community apothecary at the entrance to New Bedford’s Haskell Gardens.
description: Wild Heart Herb House is a queer- and women-owned apothecary with more than 100 dried herbs and mushrooms sold by the ounce. It carries preparations from local herbalists, making supplies, candles, incense, and handmade gifts. Classes, workshops, and free community events are part of its regular offerings.

name: Dragon Herbarium
tagline: A family-run Portland apothecary with hundreds of bulk herbs and teas.
description: Dragon Herbarium carries more than 400 bulk organic herbs and teas, along with botanical supplies and gifts. The Keith family has operated the business for over 40 years, building on a shop first opened in the 1970s. Visit its Beaverton-Hillsdale Highway storefront for ingredients and blends.

name: The Herb Shop
tagline: Bulk herbs, teas, and spices in historic downtown Grants Pass.
description: The Herb Shop offers bulk herbs, teas, spices, herbal extracts, essential oils, and supplements in downtown Grants Pass. Its selection includes botanicals sourced from growers in the Rogue Valley, with organic and wildcrafted options. Browse the storefront for blending ingredients, aromatherapy products, and other herbal supplies.

photoCandidates.alt: The Herb Shop storefront and floral mural in Grants Pass

name: Clover Apothecary at Clover Gift Shop
tagline: Vermont-made botanical products inside Woodstock’s historic Clover Gift Shop.
description: Clover Apothecary is the house botanical product line at Clover Gift Shop, a Woodstock business established in 1928. The shop offers locally crafted salves, lotions, skin creams, and hemp-derived CBD products alongside gifts and home goods. It supports Vermont makers and hosts workshops and product demonstrations.
